ReleaseNotes: SnipEX 2.2.17 is the Hallow's Eve edition: SnipEX switches to the Hallow's Eve theme once on first start after the update (Preferences still offers Light, Dark, and Hallow's Eve, and a theme you choose afterward stays) and the SnipEX app icon is dressed for the season; the standard icon returns in a later update. Existing snippets, synchronized libraries, preferences, and sign-in state are preserved. Startup updates require approval; per-user installation needs no administrator elevation. This employee-testing release remains unsigned. Windows ARM64 uses the x64 compatibility package, not a native ARM64 build.
